appendDesc.Shuffle and Block Storage: Also covers the pluggable shuffle IO API (ShuffleDataIO, driver and executor components, map output writers) with its local disk implementation, push based fetch helpers, rolling log block writers and storage reporting utilities.
appendDesc.Memory Management and Caching: Also covers the memory package errors (SparkOutOfMemoryError, TooLargePageException) and unmanaged memory consumers.

tour.title: The shuffle IO plugin API
tour.description: Where shuffle data is written can be replaced. ShuffleDataIO gives the driver and executor components; on an executor ShuffleExecutorComponents creates a ShuffleMapOutputWriter per map task, which hands out a ShufflePartitionWriter for each reduce partition and returns a MapOutputCommitMessage when committed. The default local disk implementation (LocalDiskShuffleDataIO and its writers) writes data and index files, and a single spill output can take a shortcut through SingleSpillShuffleMapOutputWriter.
